# MediaFlow Studio 1.0.0 — First release

## 🎉 First release

An everyday media toolkit for video editors, in one fast, offline Windows app.

| | Tool | What it does |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| 🔄 | **Converter** | Images, audio and video — lossless remux whenever possible, queue with progress and ETA |
| ⬇️ | **Downloader** | YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X and 1,000+ sites, in the format and quality you choose |
| ✂️ | **Trimmer** | Filmstrip timeline, in / out points, instant lossless cuts or frame-accurate export |
| 🎧 | **Audio Extractor** | Audio from any video, with loudness normalization, noise reduction and low-cut |

### Also
- 🪟 Clean installer with desktop shortcut — or a portable version
- 📦 Everything included: FFmpeg and yt-dlp, nothing to install
- 🔄 **Automatic updates** from GitHub
- 🌍 English & French · 🔊 soft UI sounds · 🔔 Windows notifications
